facts.claim: Two F-15EX Eagle II fighters assigned to the 67th Fighter Squadron landed at Kadena Air Base in Okinawa, Japan, on November 15, 2026, becoming the first of the type to be permanently stationed overseas.

Kadena is the first overseas US Air Force installation to receive combat-coded F-15EX aircraft and the second Air Force location to field the fighter, after the Oregon Air National Guard's 142nd Wing at Portland Air National Guard Base, which received its first operational F-15EX in June 2024.

The arrival is the next phase in replacing Kadena's F-15C/D Eagles, whose phased withdrawal began in November 2022 after more than four decades of service; under a plan announced in July 2024, the Air Force intends to station 36 F-15EX aircraft at Kadena, with both the 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons operating the type.

The F-15EX brings upgraded avionics, electronic warfare systems and greater weapons-carrying capacity, and is intended to strengthen Kadena's air defense capabilities alongside fifth-generation fighters and Japan Air Self-Defense Force aircraft.
Brig. Gen. John Gallemore, the 18th Wing commander, said: "These aircraft strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats, and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners."
In April 2026, the Air Force said it planned to more than double its intended F-15EX fleet to 267 aircraft.

zh.title: 美軍首批F-15EX戰機進駐日本嘉手納基地
zh.summary: 美國空軍首批兩架F-15EX戰機11月15日降落日本嘉手納基地，成為首款永久駐紮海外的F-15EX；嘉手納是首座接收戰鬥編制F-15EX的海外基地，未來將部署36架。
body: 兩架隸屬第67戰鬥機中隊的F-15EX戰機11月15日降落沖繩嘉手納基地，成為首款永久駐紮海外的F-15EX。嘉手納是首座接收戰鬥編制F-15EX的海外美軍基地，也是繼奧勒岡州空中國民警衛隊第142聯隊波特蘭基地後，全美軍第二個部署此型戰機的地點；波特蘭於2024年6月接收首架作戰用F-15EX。
這批戰機將接替嘉手納老舊的F-15C/D機隊，該機隊自2022年11月起分階段撤離，在沖繩服役逾40年；過渡期間由四代與五代戰機輪調維持戰力。根據2024年7月公布的計畫，美軍將在嘉手納部署36架F-15EX，第44與第67戰鬥機中隊都將換裝此型戰機。F-15EX具備升級的航電、電子戰系統與更大的武器掛載能力，將與五代戰機及日本航空自衛隊戰機協同作戰。

第18聯隊指揮官Brig. Gen. John Gallemore表示：「These aircraft strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats, and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners.」第67戰鬥機中隊指揮官Lt. Col. Ajay Dua表示，戰機抵達嘉手納只是開始，中隊接下來的重點是將戰機融入飛行任務、累積經驗。美軍2026年4月表示，計畫將F-15EX總採購目標由129架倍增至267架。

en.title: US Air Force's first overseas-based F-15EX fighters arrive in Japan
en.summary: The first two US Air Force F-15EX fighters landed at Kadena Air Base in Japan on November 15, becoming the first of the type permanently stationed overseas; Kadena is the first overseas base to receive combat-coded F-15EXs, with 36 planned.
body: Two F-15EX Eagle II fighters assigned to the 67th Fighter Squadron landed at Kadena Air Base in Okinawa, Japan, on November 15, 2026, becoming the first of the type to be permanently stationed overseas. Kadena is the first overseas US Air Force installation to receive combat-coded F-15EX aircraft and the second Air Force location to field the fighter, after the Oregon Air National Guard's 142nd Wing at Portland Air National Guard Base, which received its first operational F-15EX in June 2024.

The arrival is the next phase in replacing Kadena's F-15C/D Eagles, whose phased withdrawal began in November 2022 after more than four decades of service at the base; rotational deployments of fourth- and fifth-generation fighters maintained a continuous presence in the interim. Under a plan announced in July 2024, the Air Force intends to station 36 F-15EX aircraft at Kadena, with both the 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons operating the type. The F-15EX brings upgraded avionics, electronic warfare systems and greater weapons-carrying capacity, and is intended to strengthen Kadena's air defense capabilities alongside fifth-generation fighters and Japan Air Self-Defense Force aircraft.

"These aircraft strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats, and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners," said Brig. Gen. John Gallemore, the 18th Wing commander. Lt. Col. Ajay Dua, the 67th Fighter Squadron commander, said getting the F-15EX to Kadena is just the beginning, with the focus now on integrating the aircraft into flying operations. In April 2026, the Air Force said it planned to more than double its intended F-15EX fleet to 267 aircraft.
